Also use when they say "fetch this page", "pull the content from", "get the page at https://", or reference external websites. Do NOT trigger for local file operations, git commands, deployments, or code editing tasks.

- deep-research: Deep research harness — fan-out web searches, fetch sources, adversarially verify claims, synthesize a cited report. - When the user wants a deep, multi-source, fact-checked research report on any topic. Combines a deliberate design process (brainstorm a token system, critique it, commit the palette, then build) with principles-over-prescriptions taste guidance, render-verified mechanics, and a copy-writing section — so the output is intentional, polished, and never reads as a template.
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". The merger was completed on May 21, 2025, pursuant to the Agreement and Plan of Merger dated February 6, 2025, as amended on April 20, 2025. ACELYRIN became a direct, wholly owned subsidiary of Alumis.

## Deal Terms

Each ACELYRIN stockholder received 0.4814 shares of Alumis common stock for each share of ACELYRIN common stock owned, and ACELYRIN common stock ceased trading on the NASDAQ Global Select Market.

## Advisors

Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC served as financial advisor to Alumis, while Guggenheim Securities, LLC served as financial advisor to ACELYRIN.

## ESK-001 Clinical Readouts

ESK-001 is Alumis' lead candidate, formerly known as envudeucitinib. The company has several major clinical milestones expected in 2026:

**Phase 3 ONWARD Program (Psoriasis):** Topline data from Phase 3 ONWARD trials for ESK-001 in moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis is on track for readout in the first half of 2026.

## About A-005

A-005 is a central nervous system-penetrant allosteric TYK2 inhibitor that is in Phase 1 for the treatment of neuroinflammatory and neurodegenerative diseases.

## New Drug Development Move

Alumis announced it would announce additional indications for its TYK2 inhibitor franchise in the second quarter of 2026, including the CNS-penetrant TYK2 inhibitor A-005. Additionally, the company anticipated initiating a Phase I study of an unspecified clinical candidate in the second half of 2026.

The June 13 surge appears to reflect investor enthusiasm around these upcoming announcements and clinical developments for Alumis's pipeline.

## ALMS (Alumis Inc.) — Portfolio Review Block — as of 2026-06-21

**Company / lead asset (ticker confirmed)**
ALMS = **Alumis Inc.** (Nasdaq), a late-stage immunology/inflammation biopharma. Lead asset is **envudeucitinib** (formerly ESK-001), a next-gen oral selective TYK2 inhibitor. Pipeline also includes **A-005** (CNS-penetrant TYK2 inhibitor, Phase 1) and **lonigutamab** (anti-IGF-1R for thyroid eye disease, under strategic review). Ticker maps correctly — no correction needed. [Yahoo/StockTitan](https://www.stocktitan.net/news/ALMS/), [ts2.tech 2026-06-13](https://ts2.tech/en/alumis-shares-surge-16-as-traders-eye-new-drug-move/)

**Next known catalysts + timing**
- **LUMUS Phase 2b topline (envudeucitinib in systemic lupus / SLE) — expected Q3 2026.** Described by the company as "potentially pivotal." Enrollment complete. This is the key near-term binary. [Nasdaq/Alumis IR](https://www.nasdaq.com/articles/alumis-inc-completes-patient-enrollment-lumus-phase-2b-trial-esk-001-systemic-lupus)
- **Psoriasis NDA submission — on track for Q4 2026** (regulatory milestone, not a data readout). [Alumis 8-K, MarketBeat 2026-03-29](https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/alumis-spotlights-phase-iii-psoriasis-data-for-envudeucitinib-teases-nda-and-lupus-readout-2026-03-29/)
- Phase 1 start of an additional pipeline candidate expected H2 2026. [ts2.tech 2026-06-13](https://ts2.tech/en/alumis-shares-surge-16-as-traders-eye-new-drug-move/)

**What drove the stock over the last ~2 weeks**
The notable move was a **+15.55% jump on Friday 2026-06-13 to $24.15** on ~2.25M shares (>2x average volume). Attributed to renewed enthusiasm for the TYK2 franchise (envudeucitinib PsO/SLE plus the CNS-penetrant A-005) and anticipation of the upcoming Q3 LUMUS lupus readout / pipeline-expansion news — **not a new top-line data release.** It reads as sentiment/positioning ahead of catalysts plus a string of analyst PT raises, rather than a single hard news event. [ts2.tech 2026-06-13](https://ts2.tech/en/alumis-shares-surge-16-as-traders-eye-new-drug-move/), [public.com forecast (as of 2026-06-18)](https://public.com/stocks/alms/forecast-price-target)

**Did the thesis materially improve, or did price just move?**
The major fundamental de-risking happened **earlier (March 2026)**: positive Phase 3 ONWARD1/ONWARD2 psoriasis data met all primary/secondary endpoints (PASI 90 of 68.0% / 62.1%; PASI 100 of 41.0% / 39.5% by Week 24), presented as late-breaking at AAD 2026. The early/mid-June move looks **primarily price/sentiment-driven** (anticipation + analyst PT raises) on top of that already-improved thesis — no new June clinical readout verified. [MarketBeat 2026-03-29](https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/alumis-spotlights-phase-iii-psoriasis-data-for-envudeucitinib-teases-nda-and-lupus-readout-2026-03-29/), [public.com](https://public.com/stocks/alms/forecast-price-target)

**Financing / dilution flags (material)**
- **Jan 2026:** Upsized public offering — sold 20,297,500 shares at **$17/share**, gross proceeds **~$345.1M**, closed 2026-01-09. [StockTitan](https://www.stocktitan.net/news/ALMS/alumis-announces-closing-of-upsized-public-offering-and-full-j60ip8yylv1y.html)
- **March 2026:** Filed universal shelf (S-3ASR) plus a **$300M at-the-market (ATM)** equity program — adds ongoing dilution capacity. [SEC S-3ASR](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001847367/000110465926032158/tm269184d2_ex99-1.htm), [Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/us/pharmaceuticals-biotech/nasdaq-alms/alumis/news/the-bull-case-for-alumis-alms-could-change-following-envudeu)
- Cash: **$569.5M** (cash + equivalents + marketable securities) at 2026-03-31; runway guided **into Q4 2027.** [Q1 2026 results, Alumis 8-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001847367/000184736726000009/alms-20260514xex99d1.htm)
- Note: ACELYRIN merger **closed 2025-05-21** (0.4814 ALMS/ACELYRIN share) — well in the past, not a current event. [GlobeNewswire 2025-05-21](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2025/05/21/3085818/0/en/Alumis-Completes-Merger-with-ACELYRIN.html)

**Thesis-intact read**
No sign the thesis broke. Lead psoriasis program de-risked (positive Phase 3), NDA on track Q4 2026, cash runway into Q4 2027, analyst consensus **Buy** (9 analysts) with **~$40.56 avg PT** as of 2026-06-18 and multiple recent PT raises (Wells Fargo to $51, Oppenheimer to $55, Morgan Stanley to $39, Chardan to $40). Thesis appears intact/strengthening; recent price move outran new fundamentals. [public.com (as of 2026-06-18)](https://public.com/stocks/alms/forecast-price-target)

**Main risk, next 1–3 months**
1. **LUMUS Phase 2b SLE topline (Q3 2026)** is the dominant binary — a miss in lupus would be a sharp negative catalyst given run-up.
2. **Dilution overhang** from the active $300M ATM (can issue into strength).
3. Stock has rallied hard (avg cost $20.37 → $23.35, +14.6%; touched $24.15 on 6/13), so **valuation/sentiment is elevated into a binary readout.**
